name: clawd-band
description: A band above the prompt: an animated Clawd sprite, five-hour and weekly usage bars with a countdown to each window's reset, and a context-window bar with a countdown until the prompt cache goes cold

show_model.title: Show model and effort
show_model.description: Show the model and reasoning effort (e.g. Opus 5.5 high) on the line under Clawd. Off makes the band three rows tall.

sprite.title: Clawd
sprite.description: picture: a picture where the terminal draws pictures, text elsewhere. text: always text. off: no Clawd. random: picture or text.

sprite_color.title: Clawd colour
sprite_color.description: Clawd's body colour, as hex (#d77757 is Claude orange).

animate.title: Animate Clawd
animate.description: Off, Clawd still changes pose with what the session is doing, but each pose holds its first frame, and a bar with no reading yet holds still.

random_poses.title: Random pose variants
random_poses.description: Some poses have more than one animation, picked at random. Off, each pose always plays its first.

turn_endings.title: Turn endings
turn_endings.description: A short animation when a turn ends: finished, interrupted, refused or failed. Off, Clawd goes straight to rest.

bar_style.title: Bar style
bar_style.description: pill: each bar a picture where the terminal draws pictures, blocks elsewhere. In text: blocks █ or dots ⣿⣀.

cell_ratio.title: Cell shape
cell_ratio.description: How many times taller than wide one character cell of your terminal is (most fonts: 2.0 to 2.4). Pictures are drawn for this shape, so that Clawd and the pill bars keep theirs however the terminal places them.

show_weekly.title: Show the weekly bar
show_weekly.description: The seven-day usage window and the countdown to its reset.

show_five_hour.title: Show the five-hour bar
show_five_hour.description: The five-hour usage window and the countdown to its reset. With this and the weekly bar off, the account's usage is not asked for.

show_context.title: Show the context bar
show_context.description: The context window and the countdown until the prompt cache goes cold.

bar_color_weekly.title: Weekly bar colour
bar_color_weekly.description: A theme key (autoAccept, claude, suggestion, ...), a colour name (green) or hex (#4eba65).

bar_color_five_hour.title: Five-hour bar colour
bar_color_five_hour.description: A theme key, a colour name or hex.

bar_color_context.title: Context bar colour
bar_color_context.description: A theme key, a colour name or hex.

bar_color_warning.title: Weekly bar's warned days
bar_color_warning.description: The weekly bar's unused cells when its fill is inside the last two segments and fewer segments are left than days to the reset: a theme key, a colour name or hex.

bar_color_empty.title: Empty bar colour
bar_color_empty.description: The unfilled part of each bar: a theme key, a colour name or hex.

bar_color_cold.title: Context bar colour when the cache is cold
bar_color_cold.description: The context bar and its countdown once the prompt cache has lapsed: a theme key, a colour name or hex.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cache_ttl.description: How long the API keeps the prompt cache after a reply: 1h (subscriptions) or 5m (API keys, usage overage).

keep_spinner.title: Keep the spinner line
keep_spinner.description: Leave Claude Code's own spinner line in place above the band. Off, Clawd is the only thing that moves.
